name: anchor-x402
description: Eighteen x402-paid services for AI agents. This stdio package exposes 14 as tools and needs a funded EVM key in the local process; the streamable-http endpoint at https://api.anchor-x402.com/mcp exposes all 18 and takes payment per call instead, so the client keeps its own key. Pay-per-call USDC on Base or Solana mainnet, no API keys.

ANCHOR_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.description: EVM private key (0x-prefixed hex). The wallet pays for x402 calls in USDC on Base mainnet. Fund with USDC before use.
